Solana Starter Kit

WildQuest

Connect your wallet to create your on-chain player profile, start earning XP, and track discoveries and badges as your adventure unfolds.

Your player is stored in a Program Derived Address (PDA) owned by your wallet, so the game state is persistent on Solana.

Player status

Your wallet is automatically registered as a WildQuest player on first connect.

Connect a wallet to create your player PDA and load the stats.
